source_refs.note: Exercise 4.2, Question 11: Verify (AB)^t = B^tA^t, parts (i)-(ii) (book page 61).

blocks.explanation:
Humein transpose ka "reversal law" diye gaye matrices par check karna hai: product ka transpose = transposes ka product ulti tarteeb mein.
Plan: \(AB\) nikal kar us ka transpose; phir \(B^{t}\), \(A^{t}\) aur un ka product; aakhir mein dono ko compare karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -1 & 2 \\ 0 & -3 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\), \(B = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 1 \\ -3 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\)
Tasdeeq karni hai: \((AB)^{t} = B^{t}A^{t}\)
Tareeqa: Left side aur right side alag alag nikal kar entry by entry compare karenge. Dhyan dein ke right side par tarteeb ulat jati hai: pehle \(B^{t}\), phir \(A^{t}\); jaise moze pehle pehente hain aur joote baad mein, lekin utarte waqt pehle joote utarte hain.

Left side: \(AB\) ka transpose
\[(AB)^{t} = \begin{bmatrix} 4 & 9 \\ 5 & 7 \end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(AB\) ki rows ab columns ban gayin; order bhi ulat gaya.

\(B^{t}\) aur \(A^{t}\) likhein
\[B^{t} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -3 & 0 \\ 1 & -2 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\]
\[A^{t} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ -1 & -3 \\ 2 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: Har matrix ki rows ko columns bana diya. Order check: \(B^{t}A^{t}\) ka order \((AB)^{t}\) jaisa hi aana chahiye.

Right side: \(B^{t}A^{t}\) nikalein
\[(1,1):\ 1 + 3 + 0 = 4\]
\[(1,2):\ 0 + 9 + 0 = 9\]
\[(2,1):\ 1 + 2 + 2 = 5\]
\[(2,2):\ 0 + 6 + 1 = 7\]
\[B^{t}A^{t} = \begin{bmatrix} 4 & 9 \\ 5 & 7 \end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(B^{t}\) ki row \(\times\) \(A^{t}\) ka column, bilkul aam multiplication ki tarah.

Compare
\[(AB)^{t} = B^{t}A^{t} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono taraf order bhi same hai aur har jagah ki entry bhi same. Dhyan dein: \(A^{t}B^{t}\) is sawal mein ya to bana hi nahi sakte ya alag jawab deta hai; is liye tarteeb ulatna zaroori hai.

blocks.explanation:
Wohi reversal law, is dafa \(A\) ka order \(3 \times 2\) aur \(B\) ka \(2 \times 2\) hai.
Plan: left side \((AB)^{t}\), right side \(B^{t}A^{t}\), phir compare.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 4 \\ 2 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\), \(B = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -3 \\ -2 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\)
Tasdeeq karni hai: \((AB)^{t} = B^{t}A^{t}\)
Tareeqa: Left side aur right side alag alag nikal kar entry by entry compare karenge. Dhyan dein ke right side par tarteeb ulat jati hai: pehle \(B^{t}\), phir \(A^{t}\); jaise moze pehle pehente hain aur joote baad mein, lekin utarte waqt pehle joote utarte hain.

Left side: \(AB\) ka transpose
\[(AB)^{t} = \begin{bmatrix} -3 & -7 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & -5 \end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(AB\) ki rows ab columns ban gayin; order bhi ulat gaya.

\(B^{t}\) aur \(A^{t}\) likhein
\[B^{t} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -2 \\ -3 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\]
\[A^{t} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: Har matrix ki rows ko columns bana diya. Order check: \(B^{t}A^{t}\) ka order \((AB)^{t}\) jaisa hi aana chahiye.

Right side: \(B^{t}A^{t}\) nikalein
\[R_1:\ (1 - 4,\ 1 - 8,\ 2 - 2) = (-3, -7, 0)\]
\[R_2:\ (-3 + 2,\ -3 + 4,\ -6 + 1) = (-1, 1, -5)\]
\[B^{t}A^{t} = \begin{bmatrix} -3 & -7 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & -5 \end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(B^{t}\) ki row \(\times\) \(A^{t}\) ka column, bilkul aam multiplication ki tarah.

Compare
\[(AB)^{t} = B^{t}A^{t} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono taraf order bhi same hai aur har jagah ki entry bhi same. Dhyan dein: \(A^{t}B^{t}\) is sawal mein ya to bana hi nahi sakte ya alag jawab deta hai; is liye tarteeb ulatna zaroori hai.
